entries.zh: 認本分：認識自己的本分（认识自身的职分／身份）；西语疑为 conocerse a sí mismo（认识自己）
entries.en: to know one's own station/duty; to know oneself
entries.notes: 西语 mendando se 疑为 mandándose/a sí mismo 之污损或缩写展开依赖推断，故降中。

entries.zh: 心神：心神；精神、心思
entries.en: the mind and spirit; one's thoughts/attention

entries.zh: 相識：相识、彼此认识（ acquaintanceship）；相识之人
entries.en: to know each other, to be acquainted; an acquaintance

entries.zh: 面熟：面熟、见过面而相识（半识之交）
entries.en: to know each other by sight; familiar by face
entries.notes: M 栏含 hoe bin 疑为「會面」附注，汉字第三栏污损难辨，故降中。

entries.zh: 掠毛病：知人缺失、挑毛病（认识他人的过错）〔首字残疑，释义存疑〕
entries.en: to see/point out another's faults (first character doubtful)
entries.notes: 首字 [疑:掠/扐] 与 M 栏 pype 污损，汉字与音写均有缺损，释义依西语 conocer las faltas 推定。

entries.zh: 見破（爾）心：看破人心、识破心思；西语注「自知则似大恶棍」，谓自恃有识者之讥〔第二字残疑，释义存疑〕
entries.en: to see through someone's mind/heart (second character doubtful); glossed 'he who knows himself thinks himself a great knave'
entries.notes: 第三字 [疑:爾/凍] 难辨，西语 bellaco 句为编者按语式释义，整体语义推定，降低。

entries.zh: 識認：认识、辨认
entries.en: to recognize, to know (a person or thing)

entries.zh: 識心腹：识人心腹、洞悉他人心思意图
entries.en: to know a person's inner thoughts/intentions
entries.notes: M 栏三调号均 T99 污损，音写 hog 对应「腹」依赖推断，降中。

entries.zh: 會面：会面、见面相识
entries.en: to meet (face to face)

entries.zh: 認錯了：认错（承认失误）、认错了
entries.en: to admit one's mistake; to have erred

entries.zh: 所見短：所见短浅、见识少
entries.en: of limited knowledge; shortsighted understanding

entries.zh: 識（任）久：相识已久、深知〔后两字残疑，释义存疑〕
entries.en: long acquainted, well known (characters doubtful)
entries.notes: 汉字第二、三字均 [疑] 难辨，音写 y cu 与 R 栏 chy i gien 互证薄弱，依西语 conocido mucha（相识甚久）推定。

entries.zh: 歷事：历事、经历世事（有阅历）
entries.en: experienced (in worldly affairs); things one has gone through

entries.zh: 熟事：熟事、谙熟事务
entries.en: versed in affairs; familiar with matters

entries.zh: 影大：影响大、名声大（知名度高）〔「影大」构词义存疑〕
entries.en: of great repute/influence (gloss uncertain)
entries.notes: 汉字「影大」与西语 conocido mucho（很有名）对音成立但构词义不定，且官话 ying ta 平调与语义推定间存缺口，降低。

entries.zh: 出色：出色、出众（为人所知且受敬重）
entries.en: outstanding, distinguished; well-known and honored
entries.notes: M 栏 sec 调号污损，但汉字与西语互证清晰，仅调证残缺，保守降中。

entries.zh: 征：征（征服王国）、征讨
entries.en: to conquer (a kingdom); to campaign against

entries.zh: 伐：伐（讨伐、征伐）
entries.en: to attack, to subjugate by force

entries.zh: 打國度：攻打国度、攻克一国
entries.en: to attack/conquer a kingdom
entries.notes: M 栏首调 T99 污损，但汉字四栏互证清楚，保守降中。

entries.zh: 出征：出征（出兵征讨）
entries.en: to march out on campaign, to set out to conquer

entries.zh: 征伐：征伐（征讨他国）
entries.en: to conquer and subjugate; punitive expedition
